value.description: A list of concurrency groups associated with a workflow run.

group_members.description:
Items belonging to this workflow run that are either currently holding or
waiting for the concurrency group lease. May be empty if the run no
longer has any active or queued items in this group.

job_id.description: The ID of the job, when the item represents a job-level or reusable-workflow-level lease.

job_name.description: The display name of the job, when the item represents a job-level or reusable-workflow-level lease.

position.description: Queue position. 0 means the item holds the concurrency lease (in_progress), 1 or higher means queued (pending).

position_url.description: API URL to get items ahead of this item in the concurrency group.

run_html_url.description: Web URL for the workflow run.

run_id.description: The ID of the workflow run.

run_name.description: The name of the workflow run.

run_url.description: API URL for the workflow run.

group_name.description: The name of the concurrency group.

group_url.description:
API URL for this concurrency group. May return 404 if the group
has no active items at the time it is requested, since the
get-by-name endpoint reports the live repo-wide state of a group
while this endpoint lists groups associated with a run by
configuration.

total_count.description:
The total number of concurrency groups this workflow run participates in,
derived from the run's configuration. This count is not filtered by
whether the run currently holds or is waiting in each group, so it can
include groups whose `group_members` array is empty (for example, when
the run has already released its lease in that group).

value.title: Concurrency Group Run List
